@graph.headline: Manychat Guide: Features, Channels and Fit
@graph.description: Learn what Manychat does, compare its plans and active-contact limits, and see how Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok automations fit your business.

@graph.name: Manychat
@graph.description: Social media and messaging automation software for creating automated conversations across supported channels.

mainEntity.name: Does Manychat have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Free includes 25 Active Contacts per month, one user, one Inbox seat and up to four live automations. It does not include WhatsApp, SMS or Email.

mainEntity.name: Can Manychat send an automatic Instagram DM after a comment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Instagram Comments Reply trigger can watch a selected post or Reel, match keywords or any comment, and start a private reply flow.

mainEntity.name: Is Manychat a customer support ticketing system?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is mainly a chat marketing and messaging automation platform. Teams that need complex ticket queues should compare dedicated support software.
